name: banking77
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single most specific intent. When the message is about a specific product or feature that has its own intent (Apple Pay / Google Pay, automatic top-up, disposable or virtual cards, contactless), choose that feature's intent rather than a generic intent about the action (topping up, limits, fees). For example 'What is the limit for auto top-up?' is automatic_top_up.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they have received, or activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age / age requirements to open or use an account (e.g. can my child or a teenager have an account).
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or phone wallets with the card; adding the card to them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, where the nearest ATM is, whether the card works in ATMs abroad (general ATM usage questions, not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic / auto top-up: whether it exists, how to turn it on or off, how it works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A transfer (for example from a UK bank account) has been made but it doesn't show up in the account / the balance hasn't updated, including 'what is the normal time frame for a UK account transfer, I just made one and it's not showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash and the balance hasn't updated or the deposit isn't showing yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Adding a beneficiary/payee failed or a beneficiary is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/transaction they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account, 'can I cancel a transaction').
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether shops/merchants take the card; card not accepted at a particular place.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking the card in the post; card still hasn't come.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when a new card will arrive; can I get it by a certain date; expedited delivery.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account/app: adding or showing a received/found card in the app, linking an existing card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card generally doesn't work / has stopped working / not working in several places (not specific to contactless, ATMs, or a single declined payment).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; extra charge for using the card to pay.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase in the app that the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees for cash withdrawals at ATMs; charged for withdrawing cash.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal in the app the customer didn't make or doesn't recognise.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects the card has been compromised or someone else is using it / card details stolen or fraud, without the physical card being lost.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/account is available in; using or opening the account from a certain country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was declined or rejected.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / couldn't withdraw cash.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account the customer doesn't recognise or didn't set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many can I have).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address, email or phone number.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currencies.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rate is, how exchange rates are determined.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; can I exchange money / hold other currencies via the app.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Unexplained extra charge or fee on the statement (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 charge), 'why was I charged'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or didn't go through / was returned.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding, exchanging or paying; currencies the account can be in.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card once ordered, e.g. where to find the PIN for the new card or how to get the card itself.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, e.g. a second card or a card for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost or stolen or left behind; accessing the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card, card ordering options and fees.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending / what pending payment means / payment still pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / hasn't completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: The transfer is shown as pending; asking why a transfer is still pending or how long it will stay pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN/card.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from other people or a salary into the account; how to get paid.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase or how refunds work.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted / returned / money came back after a payment.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard, credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments.
criteria.terminate_account: Close, delete or terminate the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque; how to deposit cash.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on the top-up amount (maximum/minimum top-up).
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through but was then reverted / the money disappeared from the balance.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; top-up by card process.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another account/bank.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent hasn't arrived / isn't there yet / is taking too long to complete or go through (the money hasn't reached its destination), e.g. 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet'.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take, or how much longer the customer has to wait for a transfer, e.g. 'It's been a couple days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?'.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Having trouble verifying identity; verification failing or not working.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where my money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a card top-up, e.g. the verification code for a top-up card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working or being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required; why so much personal information is needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed a different amount of cash than requested or recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.
